criteria.intent: Full identification and natural first-name prose on Home and Research
criteria.automated_scope: Basic verifies coherent generated HTML; the independent source review compares the exact three reversible text replacements, full headings and unchanged links/claims. Automation does not assert editorial acceptance.

criteria.intent: Coherent dependent output and focused source verification
criteria.automated_scope: Basic includes output freshness and existing source contracts. Style and RI/CI checks cover their bounded mechanical subsets; independent review covers CS01/CS02/CS04/CS05/CS08/CS09/CS10 and the complete content/output delta.

criteria.intent: Reviewed exact-source production delivery through existing controllers
criteria.automated_scope: Basic establishes local source consistency only. Actual current-head CI, hosted preview, bounded staging, protected merge, production admission, rights/archive and live smoke require separate authenticated delivery evidence.

REVIEW.description: Separate non-implementing subagent inspects exact prepared diff and source, unchanged headings/links/claims/runtime and dependent output, policy coverage and applicable CS rules; record findings/dispositions and re-review corrections. Maintainer authorised the exact first-name wording.

DELIVERY.description: Record authenticated exact-source ready checks, preview, staging, production derivation, per-edition rights/archive and successful canonical live smoke. Maintainer explicitly authorised production in the 21 October hotfix request.

MERGED.description: Protected merge with exact tested-head and merged-tree linkage. Close only after production and live-wording verification.
